name: Roman Bondarenko
headline: Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineer with experience building reliable services, improving data handling, and supporting production systems across product teams. Known for working closely with engineers and stakeholders to deliver stable releases, cleaner integrations, and faster issue resolution.

roles.title: Software Engineer

Packaged the service layer for Kubernetes deployments and improved rollout consistency across environments.
Refined data queries in MySQL and partnered with the team to reduce slow requests during peak usage.

roles.title: Senior Backend Developer
bullets: Redesigned backend flows into Microservices and coordinated releases with CI/CD to reduce deployment delays by 40%.

Expanded automated coverage with JUnit and improved containerized delivery using Docker across the release pipeline.
